prompts.goku: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: transparent pixel-art sprite atlas for an existing 240x160 GBA-style scene. Input image 1 is the actual Goku sprite sheet from Dragon Ball Z: Buu's Fury (GBA), used as the sole exact character/design/style reference. The user wants the Buu's Fury Goku, with the original proportions, haircut, face, costume, palette and compact pixel clusters reproduced as closely as possible; no reinterpretation. Reformat and faithfully regenerate ONLY normal base-form adult Goku in his orange gi with blue undershirt, sash, wristbands and boots, with thick, solid, authentic spiky black hair. Build one clean 4-column by 3-row atlas: exactly TWELVE isolated full-body sprites, four walking-cycle frames per direction. Row 1: facing DOWN toward camera, frames contact-left/passing/contact-right/passing. Row 2: facing RIGHT in side profile, same four walk phases. Row 3: facing UP away from camera, same four phases. Columns evenly spaced, rows evenly spaced. Every sprite identical apparent scale, grounded foot baseline and head/body design, subtle opposing arm/leg movement and minimal 1-pixel bob. Each original conceptual sprite about 22x32 pixels enlarged with exact square pixels; crisp 1-pixel dark outlines, limited original GBA palette, detailed pixel clusters, absolutely no smoothing, blur, painterly pixels or photorealism. Layout: a transparent 1024x768 canvas, four 256x256 cells across, three rows. Center each sprite horizontally in its cell, baseline at 232 pixels within each cell; conceptual sprite drawn at 6x nearest-neighbor enlargement, around 132x192 pixels each. No halo, no aura, no shadow underneath, no scenery, no text, no labels, no grid lines, no combat poses, no extra frames, no hair color changes, no oversized chibi heads, no modern anime drawing. Genuine alpha transparency everywhere outside the sprite silhouettes.
prompts.chichi: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: transparent NPC pixel-art animation atlas for an existing 240x160 GBA-style scene. Input image 1 is a tightly enlarged screenshot of the actual adult Chi-Chi sprite from Dragon Ball Z: Buu's Fury. Treat this as the sole exact identity, clothing, haircut, proportions, palette and pixel-cluster reference; IGNORE the kitchen behind her. Faithfully regenerate adult Chi-Chi from Buu's Fury, with her large solid black hair mass, bun with reddish-magenta band, heavy black fringe, the exact dark upper garment, original bright gold/orange front panel with red trim and blue lower garment, matching original sleeves, hands and dark shoes. Do not redesign her clothes, add an apron or turn her into a child. Create exactly FOUR separate full-body sprites in a 2-column by 2-row atlas, same grounded stance and scale in each cell, slightly facing RIGHT in the game's three-quarter/top-down RPG perspective. These four frames form a gentle cooking/stirring cycle: her right forearm and hand hold a short thin wooden cooking spoon toward the RIGHT, around chest/waist level, shifting slightly in a circular stirring motion from frame to frame. She stands in place; hair, face, torso, skirt and feet remain stable. Include only Chi-Chi and the spoon; the cooking station and pot already exist in the scene and must NOT appear in the atlas. Exactly the source Buu's Fury pixel-art style, compact original 22x32-pixel character proportions enlarged as exact square pixels, crisp 1-pixel dark outlines, a small GBA palette, no antialiasing or blur, no smooth illustration, no oversized head. Layout: transparent 1024x1024 canvas, four 512x512 cells, two rows and two columns. Each sprite centered horizontally in its cell, aligned to baseline 464 within each cell; conceptual character drawn at 10x nearest-neighbor enlargement, around 220x320 pixels each. No text, no watermark, no labels, no grid, no background, no aura, no drop shadow, no other characters. True transparent alpha outside each figure.
